# NEW 2026-11-18 campaign enemy reactions. Generated by gen_heg_reactions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Location scope. $inf$ infantry and $cav$ cavalry regiments of the current age for scope:$owner$.
oe_hcr_units = {
    if = { limit = { current_age = age_1_traditions } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } } else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_2_renaissance_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_2_renaissance_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } } else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_3_discovery_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_3_discovery_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } } else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_4_reformation_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_4_reformation_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } } else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_5_absolutism_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_5_absolutism_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } } else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions } while = { count = $inf$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_6_revolutions_light_infantry owner = scope:$owner$ } } while = { count = $cav$ create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_6_revolutions_light_cavalry owner = scope:$owner$ } } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_hcr_foe must exist. Reinforcements at location:$loc$ while the foe owns it, else at its capital.
oe_hcr_reinforce = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_foe location:$loc$ = { owner ?= scope:oe_hcr_foe } }
        location:$loc$ = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_spawn }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_foe scope:oe_hcr_foe = { exists = capital } }
        scope:oe_hcr_foe = { capital = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_spawn } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_spawn }
        scope:oe_hcr_spawn = { oe_hcr_units = { inf = $inf$ cav = $cav$ owner = oe_hcr_foe } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Saves one war of the running campaign as scope:oe_hcr_war.
oe_hcr_save_war = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } random_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_war } save_scope_as = oe_hcr_war } }
}
# BYZ scope. scope:$who$ joins a campaign war against / alongside Byzantium.
oe_hcr_join_enemy = {
    oe_hcr_save_war = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_war exists = scope:$who$ scope:$who$ = { oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } }
        scope:$who$ = { join_war_against = { war = scope:oe_hcr_war target = c:BYZ ignore_rules = yes } }
    }
}
oe_hcr_join_ours = {
    oe_hcr_save_war = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_war exists = scope:$who$ scope:$who$ = { oe_hcr_can_join_ours = yes } }
        scope:$who$ = { join_war_with = { war = scope:oe_hcr_war target = c:BYZ ignore_rules = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Every Catholic / Muslim country thinks less of the empire.
oe_hcr_opinion_catholic = {
    every_country = {
        limit = { religion = religion:catholic }
        save_scope_as = oe_hcr_op
        c:BYZ = { reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = $modifier$ target = scope:oe_hcr_op } }
    }
}
oe_hcr_opinion_muslim = {
    every_country = {
        limit = { religion.group = religion_group:muslim }
        save_scope_as = oe_hcr_op
        c:BYZ = { reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = $modifier$ target = scope:oe_hcr_op } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Nationalist rebels from the main culture of the largest location won in campaign $idx$ (inland only
# unless $coastal_ok$ = yes); the pops of that culture there go over to them. Same way as the vanilla Alpujarras
# rising. Saves scope:oe_hcr_rebels.
oe_hcr_raise_rebels = {
    ordered_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= $idx$ OR = { always = $coastal_ok$ is_coastal = no } }
        order_by = population
        save_scope_as = oe_hcr_rev_seat
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_rev_seat }
        scope:oe_hcr_rev_seat = { dominant_culture = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_rev_culture } }
        create_rebel = { category = nationalist name = OE_HCR_REBELS culture = scope:oe_hcr_rev_culture save_scope_as = oe_hcr_rebels }
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= $idx$ OR = { always = $coastal_ok$ is_coastal = no } }
            every_pop = {
                limit = { owner = c:BYZ culture = scope:oe_hcr_rev_culture }
                change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_hcr_rebels
            }
        }
        scope:oe_hcr_rebels = { add_rebel_progress = $progress$ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. After a victory or a negotiated peace: the won land may rise in 24–60 months.
oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_hcr_rev_r value = $idx$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hcr_rev_m value = 0 }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly.
oe_hcr_pulse = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_rev_r }
        change_variable = { name = oe_hcr_rev_m add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hcr_rev_m >= 24 } random = { chance = 3 set_variable = oe_hcr_rev_go } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_hcr_rev_go var:oe_hcr_rev_m >= 60 } }
            remove_variable = oe_hcr_rev_go
            set_variable = { name = oe_hcr_rev_fire value = var:oe_hcr_rev_r }
            remove_variable = oe_hcr_rev_r
            remove_variable = oe_hcr_rev_m
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.15
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event oe_hc.3, refusing the foreign envoy: the strongest outside power bordering a campaign enemy joins.
oe_hcr_foreign_joins = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } ordered_country = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_target } any_neighbor_country = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_target } oe_hcr_can_join_enemy = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } }
    oe_hcr_join_enemy = { who = oe_hcr_joiner }
}

# BYZ scope. The Pope's call against the schismatics goes out.
oe_hcr_crusade_go = {
    ordered_country = { limit = { oe_hcr_crusader_ok = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_crusader }
    oe_hcr_join_enemy = { who = oe_hcr_crusader }
    oe_hcr_opinion_catholic = { modifier = oe_hcr_schismatic }
}
# BYZ scope. One Muslim power joins the campaign war.
oe_hcr_jihad_single = {
    ordered_country = { limit = { oe_hcr_muslim_ok = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner }
    oe_hcr_join_enemy = { who = oe_hcr_joiner }
}
# BYZ scope. With a holy city in imperial hands: a vanilla jihad against the empire, led by the Mamluks (or the strongest
# Muslim power), written the same way as the vanilla call_jihad action. Otherwise one Muslim power joins.
oe_hcr_jihad_full = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_hcr_holy
            is_valid_target_for_jihad = yes
            NOT = { any_international_organization = { international_organization_type = international_organization_type:jihad } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:MAM c:MAM = { religion.group = religion_group:muslim is_subject = no } }
            c:MAM = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_jihad_leader }
        }
        else = {
            ordered_country = { limit = { religion.group = religion_group:muslim is_subject = no OR = { country_type = location country_type = pop } oe_hcr_near_front = yes } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_jihad_leader }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_jihad_leader }
            scope:oe_hcr_jihad_leader = {
                create_international_organization = {
                    type = international_organization_type:jihad
                    target = c:BYZ
                    add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_hcr_jihad_leader
                    set_leader_country = scope:oe_hcr_jihad_leader
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = { oe_hcr_jihad_single = yes }
}

# BYZ scope, a maritime campaign starts: the spurned republic may join the enemy; the first time, both ask for a deal.
oe_hcr_maritime_start = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner var:oe_hcr_partner = 1 country_exists = c:VEN }
        random = { chance = 30 c:VEN = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } oe_hcr_join_enemy = { who = oe_hcr_joiner } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner var:oe_hcr_partner = 2 country_exists = c:GEN }
        random = { chance = 30 c:GEN = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_joiner } oe_hcr_join_enemy = { who = oe_hcr_joiner } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner_cd } country_exists = c:VEN country_exists = c:GEN }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_hcr.12 days = 5 }
    }
}

# Test helper: console 'effect oe_hcr_fire = { n = 3 }'.
oe_hcr_fire = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.$n$ }

# ======================== 埃及 ========================
# BYZ scope, at launch (after the wars are declared).
oe_hcr_egypt_on_start = {
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_raid
    oe_hcr_maritime_start = yes
}
# BYZ scope, monthly while the campaign runs. At most one reaction a month.
oe_hcr_egypt_monthly = {
    # Genoa or Venice on our side: their ships carry the supplies.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner var:oe_hcr_partner >= 1 } oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = -1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done } OR = { var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 40 location:alexandria = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.1
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_hcr_jihad_possible = yes OR = { oe_hcr_holy_city_held = yes var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 60 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.11
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done } var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 30 var:oe_hc_egypt_progress <= 70 var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 30 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.13 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done } var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 20 var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 50 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.14 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The strongest country fighting this campaign (or c:$prefer$ when it is one of them) as scope:oe_hcr_foe.
oe_hcr_egypt_save_foe = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:$prefer$ ?= { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
        c:$prefer$ = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Separate white peace with scope:$who$; it stops being a target of this campaign.
oe_hcr_egypt_peace_with = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:$who$ }
        random_current_war = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war OR = { is_a_defender = scope:$who$ is_an_attacker = scope:$who$ } }
            save_scope_as = oe_hcr_pwar
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_pwar } scope:oe_hcr_pwar = { remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war } white_peace = scope:oe_hcr_pwar }
        scope:$who$ = { remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target }
    }
}
oe_hcr_egypt_peace_weakest = {
    ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = oe_hcr_weakness save_scope_as = oe_hcr_weak }
    oe_hcr_egypt_peace_with = { who = oe_hcr_weak }
}

# ======================== 意大利 ========================
# BYZ scope, at launch (after the wars are declared).
oe_hcr_italy_on_start = {
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_raid
    oe_hcr_maritime_start = yes
}
# BYZ scope, monthly while the campaign runs. At most one reaction a month.
oe_hcr_italy_monthly = {
    # Genoa or Venice on our side: their ships carry the supplies.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner var:oe_hcr_partner >= 1 } oe_hc_italy_add_pressure = { amount = -1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done } OR = { var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 40 location:bari = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.3
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 30 oe_hcr_crusade_possible = yes }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.10
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done } var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 30 var:oe_hc_italy_progress <= 70 var:oe_hc_italy_pressure >= 30 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.13 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done } var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 20 var:oe_hc_italy_pressure >= 50 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.14 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The strongest country fighting this campaign (or c:$prefer$ when it is one of them) as scope:oe_hcr_foe.
oe_hcr_italy_save_foe = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:$prefer$ ?= { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
        c:$prefer$ = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Separate white peace with scope:$who$; it stops being a target of this campaign.
oe_hcr_italy_peace_with = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:$who$ }
        random_current_war = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_war OR = { is_a_defender = scope:$who$ is_an_attacker = scope:$who$ } }
            save_scope_as = oe_hcr_pwar
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_pwar } scope:oe_hcr_pwar = { remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_war } white_peace = scope:oe_hcr_pwar }
        scope:$who$ = { remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_target }
    }
}
oe_hcr_italy_peace_weakest = {
    ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = oe_hcr_weakness save_scope_as = oe_hcr_weak }
    oe_hcr_italy_peace_with = { who = oe_hcr_weak }
}

# ======================== 法兰西 ========================
# BYZ scope, at launch (after the wars are declared).
oe_hcr_france_on_start = {
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_raid

}
# BYZ scope, monthly while the campaign runs. At most one reaction a month.
oe_hcr_france_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done } OR = { var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 40 location:paris = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.4
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 30 oe_hcr_crusade_possible = yes }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.10
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done } var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 30 var:oe_hc_france_progress <= 70 var:oe_hc_france_pressure >= 30 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.13 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done } var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 20 var:oe_hc_france_pressure >= 50 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.14 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The strongest country fighting this campaign (or c:$prefer$ when it is one of them) as scope:oe_hcr_foe.
oe_hcr_france_save_foe = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:$prefer$ ?= { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
        c:$prefer$ = { save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = military_strength save_scope_as = oe_hcr_foe }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Separate white peace with scope:$who$; it stops being a target of this campaign.
oe_hcr_france_peace_with = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:$who$ }
        random_current_war = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_war OR = { is_a_defender = scope:$who$ is_an_attacker = scope:$who$ } }
            save_scope_as = oe_hcr_pwar
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_pwar } scope:oe_hcr_pwar = { remove_variable = oe_hc_france_war } white_peace = scope:oe_hcr_pwar }
        scope:$who$ = { remove_variable = oe_hc_france_target }
    }
}
oe_hcr_france_peace_weakest = {
    ordered_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } order_by = oe_hcr_weakness save_scope_as = oe_hcr_weak }
    oe_hcr_france_peace_with = { who = oe_hcr_weak }
}

    remove_variable = oe_hcr_raid

}
# BYZ scope, monthly while the campaign runs. At most one reaction a month.
oe_hcr_britain_monthly = {
    # Raids on the supply ships after the counter-stroke (oe_hcr.6).
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_raid } oe_hc_britain_add_pressure = { amount = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done } OR = { var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 40 location:london = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.6
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 30 oe_hcr_crusade_possible = yes }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.10
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done } var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 30 var:oe_hc_britain_progress <= 70 var:oe_hc_britain_pressure >= 30 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.13 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done } var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 20 var:oe_hc_britain_pressure >= 50 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.14 }
    }
}

    }
}

        random_current_war = {

    remove_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done
    remove_variable = oe_hcr_raid
    oe_hcr_maritime_start = yes
}
# BYZ scope, monthly while the campaign runs. At most one reaction a month.
oe_hcr_blacksea_monthly = {
    # Genoa or Venice on our side: their ships carry the supplies.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_partner var:oe_hcr_partner >= 1 } oe_hc_blacksea_add_pressure = { amount = -1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done } OR = { var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress >= 40 location:kaffa = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } location:tana = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hcr_cnt_done
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.8
    }

    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done } var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress >= 30 var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress <= 70 var:oe_hc_blacksea_pressure >= 30 }
        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_battle_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.13 }
    }
    else_if = {

        random = { chance = 5 set_variable = oe_hcr_strife_done trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hcr.14 }
